SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.employee_code AS employeeCode, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, d.name AS departmentName, des.name AS designationName, e.work_email AS workEmail, u.id AS userId, u.email AS userEmail, COALESCE(u.is_active, FALSE) AS userActive FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN designations des ON des.id = e.designation_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id OR u.employee_id = e.id OR u.email = e.work_email WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY e.id ASC
